Name: CACL_CORRECT_GRAPH_ST
Description: Piecewise curves that turn an input value into an output. The stage whose range holds the input is found (stage n runs from Threshold Point [n] to [n+1]), and the output moves from Threshold Coefficient [n] to [n+1] along a curve shaped by Adjustment Factor [n]. Inputs above Threshold Point [4] give Threshold Coefficient [4].

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [1]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 0 ends and stage 1 starts. Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [2]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 1 ends and stage 2 starts. Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [3]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 2 ends and stage 3 starts. Must not be lower than the previous point.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [4]
Fields.Description: Input at which stage 3 ends. Inputs above this are treated as this value, so the curve stays flat at Threshold Coefficient [4].

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [0]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [0]. Units depend on the system using the row.

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [1]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [1] (end of stage 0, start of stage 1).

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [2]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [2] (end of stage 1, start of stage 2).

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [3]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [3] (end of stage 2, start of stage 3).

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [4]
Fields.Description: Output at Threshold Point [4] and above (end of stage 3).

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [0]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 0. With t the input's position in the stage (0 to 1): 1 is linear, above 1 starts slow and speeds up (t^e), between 0 and 1 starts fast and slows down. Negative values mirror the curve (1 - (1 - t)^	e	), so -2 starts fast and flattens.

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [1]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 1 (from Threshold Point [1] to [2]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [2]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 2 (from Threshold Point [2] to [3]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [3]
Fields.Description: Curve exponent for stage 3 (from Threshold Point [3] to [4]). Works as Adjustment Factor [0].

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Base Multiplier
Fields.Description: Level-up cost formula: slope of the early part of the curve (alpha 1). Inherited from games with level-up costs; likely unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Flat Offset
Fields.Description: Level-up cost formula: early cost adjustment (alpha 2). Likely unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Multiplier Growth
Fields.Description: Level-up cost formula: affects the slope of the curve after the threshold (alpha 3). Likely unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Growth Threshold
Fields.Description: Level-up cost formula: threshold (t) after which the cost slope changes. Likely unused in AC6.
